from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from dotenv import set_key, dotenv_values
with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    path = Path(directory) / 'case.env'
    for original in ['TEST=ABCD', 'TEST=ABCD\n', 'TEST=ABCD\n# comment']:
        path.write_text(original)
        set_key(str(path), 'FOO', '1234')
        actual = dict(dotenv_values(str(path)))
        print(repr(original), repr(path.read_text()), actual)
        assert actual == {'TEST': 'ABCD', 'FOO': '1234'}, 'ISSUE_360_BINDINGS_CORRUPTED'
    path.write_text('')
    set_key(str(path), 'FOO', '1234')
    assert dict(dotenv_values(str(path))) == {'FOO': '1234'}, 'EMPTY_FILE_REGRESSION'
    set_key(str(path), 'FOO', 'updated')
    assert dict(dotenv_values(str(path))) == {'FOO': 'updated'}, 'UPDATE_REGRESSION'
print('All five maintainer checks passed')
